column1: # Cross-language benchmark target manifest (TSV, tab-separated, # = comment).
#   target          stable identifier used in cell/file names
#   backends        comma-separated dictionary backends this target runs
#   cpuset          taskset CPU list (single-threaded: 2; VM runtimes: 2-9;
#                   both sides of a head-to-head pair always share a cpuset).
#                   NB: 2-9 straddles two L3 domains on this host (2-7 = CCD0,
#                   8-9 = CCD1); see PROTOCOL.md section 10.2 for why that is
#                   documented as a limitation rather than changed mid-program.
#   damerau         yes|no — whether the library supports damerau_levenshtein
#   phase           execution phase that first times this target (0..4)
# Build and run command implementations live in scripts/run-one.sh as
# build_<target> / run_<target> shell functions (TSV cannot carry quoted
# shell safely); this file is the declarative list run-all.sh iterates.
